question:
What is the examination date of the patient whose albumin is the highest in the normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: examination date refers to Date; albumin is the highest in the normal range refers to MAX(ALB > 3.5 and ALB < 5.5);

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1.XCL_002
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.XCL_001 = T2.XCL_014
WHERE T2.XCL_021 > 3.5 AND T2.XCL_021 < 5.5
ORDER BY T2.XCL_021 DESC
LIMIT 1;
